messages:
lee: Follow-up from the console architecture sync: proposal to move "staged" authz checks into the query planner so cheap static checks run before expensive row-level evals.
anya: we need a clear cost model so planner can pick order (static allow/deny first, then attribute filters).
matt: agree. planner should annotate each check with estimated CPU & selectivity. small table: static->~0.5ms, row-filter->~3ms/100rows.
lee: failure modes: if a staged check times out, planner must fall back to conservative deny or sync verify depending on tenant config.
anya: metrics: authz.stage_time_ms, planner.auth_order, authz.fallback_count.
infra-bot: Note: rollout window scheduled -> 2026-04-08T09:00Z -> gradual 5/20/50/100% over 2 days.
matt: add integration tests that validate semantics under reordering and noisy tenants.
lee: I'll land a small PR with planner annotations and a feature flag. canary owners: infra + eng-platform.
anya: SGTM.
